restricted_paths: backend detector or replay contract changes
acceptance_criteria: HMI renders a detector shadow status panel fed by /detector/shadow/status.
Safe unconfigured state remains clear when FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR is missing.
Ready shadow metadata renders ready state, adapter id, model reference, labels, approval status, and authority blockers.
Existing artifact intake and detector observation panels remain compatible.
HMI screen tests prove the panel, bindings, endpoint fetch, and ready/unconfigured strings exist.
Browser verification records HMI behavior with ready template artifact intake metadata.

No backend detector contract, inference, model deserialization, camera access, raw media, production PASS/NG authority, model promotion, deploy, release, product spec approval, or QC/SOP tolerance approval is introduced.

memory_preflight.query: flange_qc_v2 HMI detector shadow status /detector/shadow/status metadata bridge artifact intake
retrieved_decisions: The shadow detector bridge endpoint is metadata-only and reads artifact intake through FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR.
The detector bridge cannot grant production authority or emit production PASS/NG.
HMI should surface operator-facing evidence without raw JSON.
retrieved_lessons: After adding backend metadata endpoints, surface actionable status in HMI.
Preserve safe empty and unconfigured states when env/intake is missing.
